title: Musa, Part 3: The Well of Madyan

lines.text: After a long journey, Musa reached the wells of Madyan.
lines.spoken: After a long journey, Musa reached the wells of Mad-yan.

lines.text: Shepherds crowded the water, but two women held their sheep back.
lines.spoken: Shepherds crowded the water, but two women held their sheep back.

lines.text: "We cannot water until the shepherds leave. Our father is very old."
lines.spoken: "We cannot water until the shepherds leave. Our father is very old."

lines.text: So Musa watered their flocks for them.
lines.spoken: So Musa watered their flocks for them.

lines.text: Then he sat in the shade and prayed: "My Lord, I truly need any good You send me."
lines.spoken: Then he sat in the shade and prayed: "My Lord, I truly need any good You send me."

lines.text: Soon, one of the women came, walking shyly.
lines.spoken: Soon, one of the women came, walking shyly.

lines.text: "My father invites you, to reward you."
lines.spoken: "My father invites you, to reward you."

lines.text: The old man heard his story and said: "Do not fear, you are safe now."
lines.spoken: The old man heard his story and said: "Do not fear, you are safe now."

lines.text: One daughter said: "Father, hire him. He is strong and trustworthy."
lines.spoken: One daughter said: "Father, hire him. He is strong and trustworthy."

lines.text: He offered Musa one of his daughters in marriage, for eight years of work, and Musa agreed.
lines.spoken: He offered Musa one of his daughters in marriage, for eight years of work, and Musa agreed.

lines.text: Years later, he saw a fire on Mount Tur.
lines.spoken: Years later, he saw a fire on Mount Toor.

lines.text: What did he find there? Follow for Part 4.
lines.spoken: What did he find there? Follow for Part four.
